expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Verify size, element values, ordering, and empty result behavior that apply to the listed overloads.
inputs: Known positive and negative receiver states, empty/default state, exact lookup keys, and boundary values implied by the listed signatures.
testScope: void check(bool Condition); | void check(bool Condition, const FString& Message); | TArray<FString> GetAngelscriptCallstack();
